gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.114: Mind where a tree falls. It can knock the next tree over, smash glass, fences and crops in its way, and a blast or a trunk with nothing under it brings a tree down with no one chopping.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.115: A felled tree stays where it falls until you chop it up. Strike the log you want with an axe; break a trunk through the middle and it comes apart in two, and whatever is left hanging drops.
